# ManyMouse vendoring notes

This directory contains an unmodified snapshot of
[icculus/manymouse](https://github.com/icculus/manymouse) at commit
`ef6dcd797e340070b9c3967097b67fa56acd8866`.

`CMakeLists.txt` is PCSX2 build integration and is not part of upstream
ManyMouse. The library sources remain under the zlib license in `LICENSE.txt`.
